The *Suttavebhaṅgiya* ("Analyses of Discourses") is a major section of the *Peṭakopadesa* (Pe 9), a methodological treatise cataloged among the later texts of the Pali Sutta corpus.

 It is also referenced or noted in relation to the *Saṁkhittasutta* (AN 4.161), the *Tiṇakaṭṭhasutta* (SN 15.1), the *Kappamāṇavapucchāniddesa* of the *Cūḷaniddesa* (Cnd 14), and the *Puggalakathā* of the *Kathāvatthu* (Kv 1.1).

 Significant reuse is also registered with canonical sutta and Abhidhamma texts, including the *Vitakkattika* of the *Paṭṭhāna* (Patthana 1.7), the *Dhātu Saṁyutta* (SN 14), the *Dasakanipāta* of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (AN 10), and the *Saṅgīti Sutta* (DN 33) [DharmaNexus].
